title: TeamTalk Music Player v2.1.9.3
changelog: New command: 'link' (or 'url') to display and share current playing song link
New command: 'fd [number]' (or 'fd a') to delete tracks or clear favorites list
Enhanced 'pf' command: can now be executed without numbers to play favorite songs seamlessly
Fixed favorite track shuffle getting stuck when pressing 'n' (skip)
Unified Favorites playback engine with PlaylistManager for consistent 'n', 'b', and 'sh' behavior
Removed spammy 'Loading...' announcements across all modes (p, pq, pf) for a clean screen-reader experience
